hook: A $2.4M budget, eight weeks to propose, and a board that wants every decision defended.
body:
This trailer follows the Meridian rollout across a year: an ADR that clears an SLA gate, RBAC at retrieval over 480,000 documents, caching and Haiku routing when the project runs $840k over budget, and gated payouts for a drifting claims agent.

Then secrets, correlation IDs and a canary rollout that knows when to revert.

Built for senior architects preparing for the Claude Certified Architect – Professional (CCAR-P) exam.

🔊 Turn the sound on for the walkthrough.
